```{python}
#| label: build-wizard
#| output: asis
# Reproduce the interface from the versioned checklist and local assets.
from pathlib import Path
from html import escape as escape_html
import json
import zipfile

root = Path.cwd()
checklist = json.loads((root / "data/checklist.json").read_text())
assert len(checklist["items"]) == 24
assert len({item["id"] for item in checklist["items"]}) == 24
assert sum(item["essential"] for item in checklist["items"]) == 9
# Bundle the complete reproducible source, excluding local drafts and QA output.
with zipfile.ZipFile(root / "assets/enlight-source.zip", "w", zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as bundle:
    paths = [root / p for p in ["index.qmd", "_quarto.yml", "README.md", "requirements.txt", ".gitignore"]]
    for directory in ["assets", "data", "scripts", "tests"]:
        paths.extend(p for p in (root / directory).rglob("*") if p.is_file() and "__pycache__" not in p.parts and p.suffix != ".zip")
    paths.extend(p for p in (root / "sources").iterdir() if p.suffix == ".pdf" or p.name in ["README.md", "LICENSE"])
    for path in sorted(set(paths)):
        if path.is_file():
            bundle.write(path, Path("enlight") / path.relative_to(root))
template = (root / "assets/wizard.html").read_text()
template = template.replace("{{ENLIGHT_CITATION}}", escape_html(checklist["meta"]["citation"]))
template = template.replace("{{ENLIGHT_DOI}}", escape_html(checklist["meta"]["doi"]))
template = template.replace("{{ENLIGHT_PMID}}", escape_html(checklist["meta"]["pmid"]))
payload = json.dumps(checklist, ensure_ascii=False).replace("</", "<\\/")
html = template.replace("<!-- CHECKLIST_DATA -->", '<script id="checklist-data" type="application/json">' + payload + '</script>')
print("```{=html}\n" + html + "\n```")
```
